ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface area with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for less than 1.5% of the total visible ventral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated high-intensity circular pixel cluster located near the trailing edge of the right lobe tip.
